# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.9 Worker 4: Global Religion Engine Deepening & 24 Holy Sites (oe_grel_). Generated by gen_v99_religion.py; edit the generator, not this file.

yearly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_grel_yearly_on_action
	}
}

oe_grel_yearly_on_action = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			country_rank = country_rank:rank_kingdom
			country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
			tag = PAP
		}
	}
	effect = {
		# 1. Great Powers & Church of the East (one-time per country)
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_grel_nestorian_patron_seen }
				NOT = { religion = religion:nestorianism }
				OR = {
					has_or_had_tag = CHI
					has_or_had_tag = YUA
					has_or_had_tag = TIM
					AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
					has_or_had_tag = ROM
				}
				oe_grel_has_nestorian_silk_link = yes
				current_year >= 1345
			}
			set_variable = oe_grel_nestorian_patron_seen
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_grel.2
		}

		# 2. Reformation & Jesuit Missions to Eastern Empires (one-time per country)
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_grel_reformation_exchange_seen }
				OR = {
					is_situation_active = situation:reformation
					is_situation_active = situation:council_of_trent
					current_year >= 1560
				}
				OR = {
					AND = {
						tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no
						religion = religion:orthodox
					}
					AND = {
						has_or_had_tag = ROM
						religion = religion:orthodox
					}
					has_or_had_tag = CHI
					has_or_had_tag = YUA
					has_or_had_tag = MNG
					religion = religion:lutheran
				}
			}
			set_variable = oe_grel_reformation_exchange_seen
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_grel.6
		}

		# 3. v9.8 Religio Romana Cross-Religion Reaction Hooks (strictly read-only!)
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_grel_byz_is_hellenic = yes
				NOT = { religion = religion:hellenism_religion }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_grel_hellenic_reaction_seen }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						religion = religion:catholic
						religion = religion:orthodox
						religion = religion:miaphysite
					}
				}
				set_variable = oe_grel_hellenic_reaction_seen
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_grel.9
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					religion ?= { group ?= religion_group:muslim }
				}
				set_variable = oe_grel_hellenic_reaction_seen
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_grel.10
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						religion = religion:hindu
						religion = religion:tengri
						religion = religion:sanjiao
						religion = religion:mahayana
						religion = religion:shinto
						religion = religion:theravada
					}
				}
				set_variable = oe_grel_hellenic_reaction_seen
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_grel.11
			}
		}
	}
}
